ZWE.note: The Tier 4 data centre is a government project not yet built; the existing national data centre serves government only.

facts.fact: ICT Minister Tatenda Mavetera said Zimbabwe is upgrading its national cloud infrastructure and will establish a new Tier 4 national data centre with the e-Government Technology Unit, targeted for completion by end 2025.
facts.system: National cloud upgrade and new national data centre

facts.fact: Government digital platforms including email and ministry websites run on the government's national cloud and data centre infrastructure, with the Government Internet Service Provider hosting ministry websites, according to the ICT Minister.

ZWE.note: Migration of ten ministry websites to the .gov domain is not a count of services online.
The Tier 4 standard is a data centre design level, not an adopted national standard.

facts.fact: The Minister said Government digital platforms, including email and communication services, are hosted in the national data centre, which is being expanded into a new Tier 4 facility.

ZWE.note: No data centre for hire stated; the Tier 4 centre is not yet built.
Redundancy measures mentioned with no backup site or place named.
